def predict(designs, params):

import numpy as np

def predict(designs, params):
    # params shape: (n_particles, 6) for 3 sources × 2D
    n_particles = params.shape[0]
    n_designs = designs.shape[0]
    designs_exp = designs[None, :, :]  # (1, n_designs, 2)
    params_exp = params[:, None, :].reshape(n_particles, n_designs, 3, 2)  # (n_particles, n_designs, 3, 2)
    diff = designs_exp[:, :, None, :] - params_exp  # (n_particles, n_designs, 3, 2)
    dist = np.sum(np.abs(diff), axis=-1)  # L1 norm (n_particles, n_designs, 3)
    b = 0.3  # scale parameter
    amplitude = 1.0
    laplace = amplitude * np.exp(-dist / b)  # (n_particles, n_designs, 3)
    signal = np.sum(laplace, axis=2)  # (n_particles, n_designs)
    return signal

def sample_prior(rng, n):
    # Uniform source centers in [-2,2]^2 for 3 sources
    return rng.uniform(-2, 2, size=(n, 6))
